nom: IT Cosmetics Bye Bye Makeup 3-in-1 Makeup Melting Cleansing Balm

avis.texte: This is the most effective and moisturizing makeup remover I have ever used. I have been using for about 2 years and it's my go to for removing my makeup, especially waterproof mascara, without the need for pretreatment or aggressive scrubbing. My skin feels soft and moisturized after use. The only con is the lack of a travel size.

I loved the previous version of this product - but the new formula is a massive downgrade. The texture isnt as nice, it feels waxy almost. It works just as well for me, but the smell! It's like it wants to be minty, but isn't, and also smells old somehow. I'll use this jar, probably, because of what I paid, but not buying it again.

The scent alone is enough that once I get through this jar I will not be buying this again. This version doesnt even work as well as the original Bye Bye Makeup, often I have to do another round on my mascara and I dont even use waterproof. And my skin doesnt feel near as soft as it use to. Does it get your makeup off, yes that's why it gets two stars.

avis.titre: Really nice feeling on skin after use!
avis.texte: I've had a difficult time finding an actual make-up remover that REALLY removes the make-up without leaving a make-up residue still after use. This comes closer than others I tried before but I still find I need to use a face wash afterwards to totally remove the make-up film. I do love the feel of the product and after (if not having to also face wash) my skin feels soft and not dried out.

avis.titre: I would not buy this product again.
avis.texte: Broke out in cyst blemishes a several hours after I used it. I don't get blemishes. I saw ingredients listed that are toxic on label, harmful to health, according to internet search. This is not a clean product. No reviews were posted. Wonder why?
Has a very strong scent and I've used other products like this that worked better. Mant times I have to use makeup remover afterwards to remove the rest of my mascara (and I don't use waterproof).
I have been using this for years!! It is the one of the best makeup removers. I try to watch for sales.
The product does what it says, but I do not particularly like the scent. I got it on sale and I'm not sure that I would pay full price for it.

As a cleanser, it is impossible to remove. It does not easily remove with water after being worked into oil. Also, the rose scent is very strong. A little does go a long way if you are willing to put in the work to remove it. However, my skin did not feel super clean after use.
I really wanted to like this product and while it did a good job removing my makeup and mascara , it irritated my eyes and made them water for hours after using. I had to return it.

avis.titre: Burns eyes, doesn't rinse off easily (loved the old formula)
avis.texte: This newer formula burns my eyes and doesn't remove all mascara like the old formula. It does apply silky feeling but its harder to rinse the "film" off. The older formula didnt do that. I used to live this but Will unfortunately have to switch to the cliniqie take the day off.
It takes using it a few times before I got used to the thickness of it. But it did work great on getting my mascara off.

avis.titre: Burned my face due to fragrance
avis.texte: I purchased this product today at Ulta and it did melt off my makeup, but it burned my skin assuming due to the fragrance. It looks like I have sunburn on my face. Unfortunately I will be returning this product tomorrow.
I have dry skin, and this goes on like silk, easily gliding on and no pulling or tugging! It takes off all my makeup, and isn't harsh on my sensitive skin.

This is effective at melting off makeup. it does require a little more work to rinse off than foaming cleansers, so you might use a little more water during rinsing. My skin feels very soft and smooth after using it. I don't feel that tightness that I get with most cleaners that will send me looking for my moisturizer as soon as my face dries. I really do like this a lot. I have picky sensitive skin and eyes, but absolutely no issues with this, even using to remove eye makeup. that all being said, man, it's pricy. There does seem to be a generous portion in the jar, though. It's the first balm I've tried, so I will definitely experiment with brands and compare performance with co$t.

avis.titre: Love the product but the smell is horrible
avis.texte: I used this product religiously for many years but they redid the formula when they rebranded the jar. The smell is so strong that I couldn't finish the jar. I don't know why they'd intensify the scent when most people are moving towards unscented products.
I give this 2 stars because it works, but the smell will keep me from using it.
Yo nunca eh sufrido de acne pero con este desmaquillante se me broto la cara horrible PORFAVOR NO LO COMPRES

I started using cleansing balms at the start of the year because I was tired of having to do a two-step process removing eye makeup with one product then cleansing again all over my face with something else. I looked for balms to do both. I bought both the IT cleansing balm and the Clinique equivalent. Clinique does the job perfectly and everything rinses clean. After cleansing thoroughly with the IT balm and paying particular attention to my eye makeup ( and i don't even use waterproof mascaras) i was left with horrible racoon eyes. I have to do a second round of cleaning with micellar water to clean it all up. Last time i'll purchase the IT balm. Clinique is my go-to now. Better price and value too when i got a BOGO. Rinses clean. Doesn't irritate my eyes either.

avis.titre: I buy this product again  and again!
avis.texte: This product is easy, effective and my skin always feels clean. I bought this initially because I wanted a simple cleanser when camping. Now it's my go to!

avis.titre: I so wanted to love this, but causes me to breakout
avis.texte: I have used many balms, and i wanted to love this but everytime i use this after 2 days i get acne! I had stopped using and used a competitor and it got better. Its like you have to make sure you double wash my face after (which defeats the purpose) i always double cleanse! First ingredient is not acne friendly.

I got this because I was looking for something new that lasted longer. I was researching cleansing balms and was leaning towards a very expensive alternative until I stumbled on this in-store. My former cleanser just never had enough in the bottle to last very long and I was spending way to much to replenish. I actually love this balm. I've been using it for about 2 weeks now. Melts the makeup right off. It isn't drying and my skin retains moisture. I was hesitant because my skin is very sensitive. No issues here. Smells like roses. Works great! I don't have to follow with any other products to remove residual makeup. It does what it's designed to do. I follow with Confidence in a Cream. I will buy it again.

I love this product, but I use both of your makeup remover. I love that your product are different. You don't use water with this remover so I don't get water all over me when I use it at the sink. And I love the other one because when I shower I use it.
Live this. Make up come off fast and easy. Makes my skin so soft.

I tried this on a whim and so happy I did. It literally melts off your make up, sweat, etc. it smells fantastic and it only product that leaves my face clean without feeling stripped and dry It's fantastic Try iy
It's so creamy and melts on your face. Can smell the rose hip oil. I like that you can leave it on as a mask too.

avis.titre: I got this and love it (not a fake review)
avis.texte: I absolutely love this makeup remover. I went in to Ulta to buy a tarte lip plumper and swatched a few on my hand, and this is what they gave me to remove it. I loved it and asked where there was one for me to buy and bought it that day.
I use this product to remove my makeup with ease! I would recommend this to anyone who is looking for an easy way to remove their makeup.
I was not expecting this product to be so good but it is. Takes your makeup off like a dream and leaves the skin feeling moisturized not dry! And the smell is amazing!! Love this product!
repeat purchase because it works! great for sensitive skin and all ages.
I love that I can remove my makeup and cleanse my face with one product. My skin loves it too!
I really like this product. Feels good going on and does remove makeup welll. I Liked the original formula best but this is still good!

I have used this cleansing balm in the past and may I say this removed everything and my skin was soft and supple. I recommend it but personally if it didnt have parfum in it i would repurchase again.
I always come back to this cleansing balm it does the job and then some
This makeup remover is amazing! It leaves your skin feeling so refreshed and hydrated. And not to mention how soft your skin feels.

avis.titre: Great makeup remover for pm and moisturizer for am
avis.texte: This is a fabulous way to remove makeup, plus I use it in the mornings to hydrate my skin, before I wash my face. The smell is divine, and it really hydrated my skin in the mornings. This really improved the quality of my life.
So easy to use! No washing my face over the sink. Leaves my skin feeling clean and soft

This cleansing balm will remove your makeup and leave your skin feeling moisturized. It does not do a good job of removing eye makeup like the original balm did, and this one has the rose smell which I personally do not prefer.

avis.titre: I was not expecting to like this
avis.texte: I loved the original but this one works for me as well. A little goes a long way.

I really wanted to love this product, but I will be returning. It makes my skin angry. My face gets very very red and itchy after using. My skin is also starting to flake... I'm an It Girl through and through but this I will be returning.
I was expecting a creamy cleanser. It feels like a candle and very hard to get out enough for my face
I am horrible at washing my face--especially after wearing makeup. This balm makes me WANT to! It smells amazing and a little bit goes a long way. I absolutely love this product!

avis.titre: Holy moly this is the best
avis.texte: Oooh the heavenly scent that I'd like to have in my body wash, shampoos, candles, wax - its that good but wait, there's more… Effective & leaves my skin soft to the touch, like a daily present to myself. You will ❤️ this cleanser i and effective's are ridiculously great

The bye bye makeup cleansing balm is so light and refreshing to use at the end of the day. It leaves your skin feeling very fresh and clean and really does take off all the make up. It's my favorite to use in the evening.
I love the smell of this makeup remover. It feels soft and silky and does a great job removing my make up!

This is the next best thing I found to the original! It smells good, but doesn't clean as well, and it stings my eyes ever so slightly while the original one did not. Please, please please consider you back the original.
My skin feels soft and moisturized after using Bye Bye Makeup Cleansing Balm. Love it!
Melts onto your skin to easily remove makeup. A little goes a long way.
I love that it's solid, but melts when you rub it in your hands. A little goes a long way for me because of that!

I loved the cleansing Balm makeup remover. I have sensitive skin with no issues. I loved how my makeup literally melted off my skin and left it feeling hydrated and clean. The new product has something in it that made my skin have a bad reaction. (rash all over my face).
this is fantastic! it melts off even stubborn waterproof mascara! it smells wonderful too
This is the best cleansing cream ever. Feels good, smells good and leaves your face clean.
Love the way it makes my skin feel. It is not greasy like some makeup balm removers
Takes off makeup beautifully! Leaves skin feeling soft and nourished! Smells great! Good size, product lasts quite a while! I also love leaving it on my face like a hydrating mask;)
Love this product as my first step in skincare, takes off my eye makeup with ease

I have extremely dry skin and this make-up remover is fantastic for that. Most make up removers leave my skin feeling dry and cracky but this one leaves it feeling moisturized. Definitely recommend this product.
I personally like the smell and it makes my skin feel soft . It does a decent job of removing makeup as well.
Takes off my full coverage foundation with ease. Smells great and leaves my skin feeling smooth and hydrated.

I absolutely love this makeup remover! I had purchased the "older" version and was happy with it, so I was concerned about using the new one, but I gave it a try. I was glad that it did. It removes all of my makeup very easily.
The only product that I use that removes all makeup (waterproof too) off without using another cleaner to complete the cleansing. Skin feels refreshed and pores are clean.

avis.titre: excellent removal product that smells great
avis.texte: i wanted a product to specifically remove my long-lasting lipstick. This works perfectly. Smells great and leaves my skin feeling soft and refreshed.
Never had a product that removed my makeup so completely as well as leaving my skin so moisturized. Absolutely love this stuff!
Liked how this removed mascara but left the rest of my face feeling greasy and after using a few times, had more breakouts than usual.
I love Bye Bye Makeup Cleansing Balm. It's easy to use and the makeup melts right off of your face without having to scrub your skin.

avis.titre: Used to be 5 stars, downgraded to 1
avis.texte: I very rarely write reviews but this is important. Hands down this used to be the best skincare/makeup product I've ever found. 5 stars all day. Removes all my waterproof makeup effortlessly. They recently changed the formula and the scent now is nauseating and overpowering. Why "fix" what is not broken? Look at all these reviews complaining about this horrendous scent and make a change before we all find a new holy grail. I have 2 jars (1 just opened and 1 new) that I'm contemplating returning. IT Cosmetics get your stuff together and listen to your buyers!
Really cleanses your face in just one go around when you was your face
Love this product. Not greasy or oily at all. Rinses clean off the skin. Cleans very well. No traces of makeup leftover.
This balm applies so smoothly and really leaves my skin hydrated
Removes makeup sunscreen and dirt so well and doesn't dry out my skin. I use it daily as part one of my double cleanse
I love it! It makes my face look so good and it smells amazing! I use it to take my makeup off and then I put some on and leave it.
Love it! Easy on the eyes and smoothly removes stubborn makeup.
I love this product in the morning before my make up I was my face and it's so easy to put my make up on face feels so soft. At night is so easy to wash away my make up.

I can't live without this cleaning balm. I have to wear waterproof mascara because my eyes water too much. This cleansing balm removes it so easily and it's gentle. I love the way my skin feels after using it as well.
Amazing. Moisturizing. Great smell. Removes makeup and leaves skin feeling clean without drying.
Love this balm. Melts makeup, even waterproof mascara, right off. Feels wonderful on skin also.
Really like this remover over normal cleanser. Leaves my skin feeling good and not dried out.

I have never been so happy with a product and that it does exactly what it describes! I usually don't enjoy taking my make up off, but I love this balm. It feels so good, removes makeup and mascara beautifully, and your skin feels wonderful! And it is all the three things in one! It lasts a very long time, and my partner likes to use it too. It is worth the investment hands down!
I love, love, love this makeup cleansing balm! It is so effective and leaves my skin feeling great!
Best makeup remover I have ever used! Literally just melts away makeup no hard scrubbing at all! Face is so soft afterwards!

I love this cleanser it remove my water proof mascara in a breeze. It also removes all of my make up without having to tug in stretch the skin around my eye area!!! Leaves my skin feeling clean and smooth.
Does a good job removing foundation. Makes removal easier and not abrasive.

I love the rosey smell and how this cleanser makes my skin feel. I leave it on for up to 15 minutes to "soak" into my skin and it leaves it feeling soft and clean. It really is the very best makeup remover!
Best makeup remover cleanser on the market. Easily removes eye makeup without any tugging or pulling and feels like a spa treatment
MOISTURIZING, CLEANS OFF ALL OF MY MAKE UP, WON'T USE ANYTHING ELSE
I love this product! It removes makeup and moisturizes my skin.
Leaves skin feeling so soft and smooth. Instantly can see the makeup lifting off my face within seconds of applying it.
Melts makeup right off my face, I even use to get mascara off.
Great makeup remover, smells wonderful, and does wonders for the skin. Will def repurchase.
This does a great job of removing my make up. It doesn't leave my face feeling greasy, just completely make up free.

avis.titre: I love the way this product removed my makeup.
avis.texte: With this product you only have to use it once to remove every bite of your makeup. It once and done.

avis.titre: Like a dessert for my skin
avis.texte: It took me a moment to get used to this product vs the old formula but, once I embraced the changes, I fell in love. This formula is best wiped off with a warm damp cloth. It leaves my skin soft and moisturized and my skin tone even. This product does have a light rose scent. I am one who is sensitive to smells and this scent doesn't bother me one bit. It's just a lovely product and it's a fun way to end the day.
Love this makeup remover. Very gentle and works great. No scrubbing at all. Leaves skin clean and soft.

I loved the original formula but I tried two other cleansing balms and found the products to have poor cleaning results or they smelled like nasty chemicals. I returned back to this products even though I didn't think I would like the rose smell. The smell is pleasant and I love the results. 😊
gets ALL makeup off with a single application. Not harsh on skin
Feels great on skin and removes all makeup while making skin feel luxurious!!

I use this nightly to take off my IT products. It doesn't dry out my parched, sensitive skin, and I love the way my face and neck feel after I wash it off. No need to worry about clogged pores after using my cleansing balm.
My skin is so clean and soft after using this. I never use another product
This works very well, I love having an alternative to the regular cleansing soap I use, it gives the skin a glow, it moisturizes also! I very highly recommend adding this to your routine.

I usually use another brand's make up removing balm, but I thought I'd try this one since it was a great deal during Ulta's Skin event. I like it so much that I was so excited when Ulta included it on their "last chance" day because I could buy another tub to save for later! It removes make up so well without drying. It has a rose smell which I kind of like. I would recommend this product 100% and I'm so happy that I have TWO tubs now =)
Love this remover. It gently removes all kinds of make up and leaves skin feeling soft and hydrated.
Great cleanser to remove glam and mascara. I usually put on before a shower. Def recommend using as a first step of a double cleanse.

I had such high hopes for this product! I gave it a month, and it did not work for me. Does it remove makeup? Mostly yes. Does it leave a greasy residue? Also yes. Is it overpriced for its effectiveness? Heck yes. Does that greasy residue cause acne breakouts? ALSO YES. I will be going back to my $8 micellar water or the $20 Purity facewash from Philosophy. Much better on my skin and does a better job, in my opinion.
Love using this to take eye make up off. some things bother my eyes and this doesn't
I absolutely love this balm. It thoroughly removes all of makeup all while softening my skin. Has a nice, light fragrance, too. Highly recommended

avis.titre: Love balm hate the rose hip scent
avis.texte: I have been using your balm forever and I hate the smell of it. Can you please at least offer your original balm with no scent. Even my husband hates the smell of it. I have a severe nerve condition in my face and scents just don't help it at all. I need the balm as I can't press on my face even with Purity without screaming and crying. The balm idea is fantastic, but not that rose hip. Please help or I will have to find another company that makes a balm and I had already put it on autoship.
Great product. I have been using this for the last couple of years. Great for taking off makeup

This has been by far the best makeup remover i have used. It does not dry out my skin, it doesn't drip in your eyes like other products do. It completely removes all makeup to include waterproof. The scent is very faint , the old version had a stronger scent. Wish it still had that.
Love how it moisturizes as well as a cleanser and how it feels on your face
One of my favorite products of all beauty time! Effortlessly takes off your make up and day! So gentle and effective, delightful scent.
This balm does the job of removing all of my makeup, including waterproof. Love the smell and leaves my skin feeling super silky and soft.
Wonderful balm to remove eye makeup and face makeup. Very hydrating. A bit greasy, but moisturizing.
This is my favorite IT product. It is the best makeup remover ever. I use a warm wet rag to wipe it off and my skin feels so soft and smooth after that.
Really moisturizes the skin and makes it feel soft. I also use as a mask especially in winter months. I was surprised how well it temoved the makeup.
Feel amazing on my skin and easy to use. I have also used as a 10 min mask. Washes off easily and for move eye makeup and mascara!!!!!
Make up remover is amazing! All make up and leaves your skin healing very Clean.
